newsitem.title: USA: Hytek sees 1997 revs 20-25 pct below 1996.
newsitem.headline: Hytek sees 1997 revs 20-25 pct below 1996.

text.p: Hytek Microsystems Inc said Turesday it expects 1997 revenues to fall 20 to 25 percent from 1996's $8.6 million due to lower shipments for customer Chesapeake Sciences.

In a statement, Hytek cited "fluctuating end-user demand" as the reason for the declining shipments to Chesapeake. It said Chesapeake's geophysical exploration market can be volatile and revisions to delivery schedules are not unusual.
Hytek today reported 1996 earnings of $0.62 per share on sales of $8.6 million versus $0.18 a share on sales of $5.4 million in 1995.
